waiver.text: The two sides render as separate board panels the player switches between, and duel.tsx's own legal-cell computation returns no legal cells at all for rotating or placing unless the player is viewing their own board, so cross-board manipulation is impossible by construction, not just unlabeled.
waiver.expiresIf: duel.tsx's legal-cell computation stops gating rotation and placement on the current view being the player's own board, or the two boards stop rendering as separate panels.

label.why: MECHANIC_INVENTORY has no row for splitBoards at all (the silent-gap class), so the waiver above has nothing to attach to until this row exists. Chained after 07-builtVsPower.json's insertion so all three land without colliding.

claims.resolves: Side is the union "player" | "opp", exactly two values, one per board panel the player switches between.

the legal cell set returns out (empty of new adds) for rotation and placement whenever view !== "player", so the enemy board can only ever be reached through ATTACK targeting, never direct manipulation.
